---
title: "LEVANTE analysis"

---

Analyses of the LEVANTE core-task battery by the Data Coordinating Center:
data quality across the network, the psychometrics of each task, and dated
investigations of specific questions. Data come from pinned releases of
`levante_data_latest` on Redivis, and each page states the data it ran on.

::: {.section-grid}

::: {.section-card}
[Monitor](monitor/index.qmd){.stretched-link}

What the current data look like across the battery: coverage, data quality,
growth, construct structure and test–retest.
:::

::: {.section-card}
[Task reports](tasks/index.qmd){.stretched-link}

Everything about one task: its items, scores, reliability and validity.
:::

::: {.section-card}
[Studies](studies/index.qmd){.stretched-link}

Dated investigations of one question each, with their verdicts and the data
they were run on.
:::

::: {.section-card}
[Findings & decisions](register/index.qmd){.stretched-link}

What we have concluded and what was decided, each linked to its evidence.
:::

:::

{{< include /_disclaimer.qmd >}}

The site is being reorganized (October 2026). Some pages still run on the
2026-08 per-site data snapshot rather than the pinned release; each page's
data line says which. Release-level reliability, age and test–retest
summaries are on the [LEVANTE datapage](https://levante-framework.github.io/levante-datapage).
The house rules for these pages are in the repository's
[charter](https://github.com/levante-framework/levante-analysis/blob/main/CHARTER.md).
